business.dashboard.title: Timeblock Business Console
business.dashboard.heading: Business and partner overview
business.dashboard.intro: Business accounts are separate from member accounts. This console manages business profile data, brand display, integration readiness, TBQR / API planning, plan activation, support, and governance status.
business.summary.account_status.help: Business account review status is controlled by Timeblock admin.
business.summary.partner_status.help: Used to assess business or project partnership readiness.
business.summary.current_plan.help: Business entitlements must come from a plan, contract, quota, or admin approval.
business.summary.points_balance.help: Read from the Phase 9 Business wallet; business referral rewards are not auto-issued yet.
business.summary.homepage_display.help: Brand logos and links require review before public display.
business.profile.panel.title: Business profile
business.profile.empty.description: No business description has been added yet.
business.profile.empty.website: No website URL has been set yet.
business.plan.activation.title: Plan activation
business.plan.activation.active: Business plan activated through payment request:
business.plan.activation.empty: No paid business plan is active yet. Create a payment request, submit payment details, and wait for operations review before governed business capacity is enabled.
business.entitlements.title: Business creation entitlements
business.entitlements.body: Use activated business entitlements to create governed events and external linked products. Internal-point events must still follow Timeblock policy and activity ledger rules.
business.creation.free_event.title: Business free participation event
business.creation.free_event.allowed: Free participation events can currently be created.
business.creation.points_event.title: Internal-point ticket event
business.creation.points_event.allowed: Internal-point ticket events can currently be created.
business.creation.linked_shop.title: Business linked shop
business.creation.linked_shop.allowed: External linked products can currently be created.
business.creation.locked_help: This entitlement is not open yet. Check plan capacity or operations review status.
business.entitlement.allowed_event: This business account can currently create this event type.
business.entitlement.allowed_shop: This business account can currently create linked product cards.
business.module.overview.label: Overview
business.module.overview.summary: View account status, plan, homepage display, and partnership readiness.
business.module.profile.label: Business profile
business.module.profile.summary: Manage company description, industry, website, and public partner copy.
business.module.branding.label: Brand display
business.module.branding.summary: Manage logo image URL, website links, homepage review requests, and display status.
business.module.business_wallet.label: Business internal-point wallet
business.module.business_wallet.summary: View business internal points, activity ledger, TBQR attribution, and recent block records.
business.module.business_internal_fgo.su: View business Internal FGO balance, conversion eligibility, and review request records.
business.module.projects_api.label: Projects / API
business.module.projects_api.summary: Manage API tokens, Webhooks, usage metrics, and integration readiness.
business.module.projects_api.body: The business integration entry is available in business integrations. API tokens and Webhooks remain governed by Timeblock admin, service-layer contracts, and governance rules.
business.module.qr.label: QR / TBQR
business.module.qr.summary: Create governed TBQR short links and QR files, and view scan attribution and entry records.
business.module.qr.body: TBQR uses standard QR codes that point to Timeblock short links. Business-created QR entries remain governed; sensitive routing data stays server-side and scans become auditable records.
business.module.billing.label: Plans and payment
business.module.billing.summary: View plans, PayPal / USDT payment requests, and activation status.
business.module.billing.body: Business entitlements are enabled through plans, contracts, quota, payment review, or admin approval. Payment does not bypass governance, risk controls, or service-layer controls.
business.module.support_audit.label: Support and audit
business.module.support_audit.summary: View support records, review status, role activity, and audit summaries.
business.module.support_audit.body: Support and audit pages provide review status, policy copy, and operations summaries without exposing sensitive admin data or internal security details.
business.module.placeholder.title: Phased feature note
business.module.placeholder.body: This page is opened early so business users can understand the feature roadmap; sensitive operations remain behind operations review and service controls.
business.login.title: Timeblock Business Login | Business Console
business.login.heading: Sign in to Timeblock Business Console
business.login.intro: This entry is for businesses, brands, and partner projects to manage profile data, integration readiness, TBQR / API planning, and governance status.
business.login.identity_note: Business accounts and member accounts are separate identity domains.
business.apply.title: Apply for a Timeblock business account | Business partnership
business.apply.heading: Apply for a Timeblock business account
business.apply.intro: Business accounts manage brand data, events, TBQR, API / Webhook, plan payment, and governance review. This does not create a member wallet and does not bypass the Timeblock activity ledger.
business.apply.note: After creation, the account enters review status; homepage partner brand display still requires separate Timeblock admin approval.
business.form.industry_placeholder: Retail / events / local services / membership operations
business.form.short_description_placehol: Describe the business or partner project in 1-2 sentences.
business.profile.title: Business profile
business.profile.heading: Business brand profile
business.profile.branding_heading: Brand logo and homepage partner display
business.profile.intro: Business profile data creates a public partner identity; homepage display still requires Timeblock admin approval.
business.profile.branding_intro: Businesses can submit logo image URL, website, industry label, and homepage display review request. Public display still requires Timeblock admin approval.
business.profile.logo_empty: No logo image URL has been set. Use a publicly readable HTTPS image URL.
business.profile.request_homepage_review: Submit homepage partner brand display review
business.profile.homepage_status_help: Only approved or featured business accounts appear in the homepage partner brand area.
business.event.heading: Create business event
business.event.intro: Business events use plan quota or admin-approved entitlements. Internal-point ticket events must remain within Timeblock governance and activity ledger rules.
business.event.title: Event title
business.event.social_share_required: Free participation requires social share verification
business.shop.heading: Create linked product card
business.shop.intro: Business linked shop only creates external partner link cards. Business redemption shop is a separate governance and entitlement flow and is not mixed with linked cards.
business.shop.title: Product card title
business.status.applied: Business account created. Please sign in, complete the business profile, and wait for Timeblock operations review.
business.status.apply_incomplete: The business account application was received but is not complete yet.
business.status.profile_updated: Business profile updated. If homepage review was selected, the display status will move to pending review.

business.error.password_mismatch: The two password entries do not match.
business.error.company_required: Please enter a company or project name.
business.error.email_required: Please enter a business admin email.
business.error.email_exists: This business email already has an account. Please sign in directly.
business.error.password_too_short: Password must be at least 8 characters.
business.error.event_prize_required: Please describe the goods or gift for this event.

business.error.shop_url_required: Please enter an external partner link.

business.dashboard.error.body: Business data is not ready yet. Please try again later.
business.dashboard.evidence.title: Campaign performance
business.dashboard.evidence.body: Budget, campaign, reach, and engagement metrics appear only when verified V1 data is available.
business.dashboard.analytics.title: Scans over time
business.dashboard.analytics.body: Metrics are read from this business's TBQR links for the last 90 days.
business.dashboard.analytics.empty.title: No TBQR scan data yet
business.dashboard.analytics.empty.body: The chart will appear after this business creates a link and receives scans. No substitute values are generated.
